status: fixture contract for P12; not an implemented importer API

format.malformed_csv: Reject file if reliable record boundaries cannot be recovered

columns.name: source_record_id
columns.handling: Private source-native identity; never an organisation UUID.

columns.name: entity_name
columns.handling: Candidate organisations.entity_name after identity and field review.

columns.name: entity_kind
columns.handling: Private classification; branch/service mappings remain held for review.

columns.name: abn
columns.handling: Candidate legal_details.abn; format only, not verified; never a merge key alone.

columns.name: incorporation_jurisdiction
columns.handling: Retain with incorporation_number as a private identifier assertion; publication mapping requires P12 review.

columns.name: incorporation_number
columns.handling: Preserve leading zeroes; require jurisdiction when present; no registry validation asserted.

columns.name: website
columns.handling: Candidate contact_info.website; syntax is not ownership or reachability.

columns.name: locality
columns.handling: Private locality evidence; no inferred street address or service coverage.

columns.name: postcode
columns.handling: Private locality evidence; string preserves leading zeroes.

columns.name: scope_basis
columns.handling: Private inclusion-review evidence; not automatic eligibility.

columns.name: service_area
columns.handling: Private supplied service-area text; not geocoding or boundary proof.

columns.name: category
columns.handling: Private source category; map against P01 in review.

columns.name: description
columns.handling: Private context for this fixture; not approved for automatic publication.

columns.name: evidence_ref
columns.handling: Private source reference; fixture: references below are synthetic, not live evidence.

columns.name: source_modified_at
columns.handling: Source modification time, separate from file observation; blank means unknown.
